text:
The plate holds about 4-5 pineapple chunks and 3-4 honeydew melon chunks.

Pineapple: about 5 pieces at roughly 15 g each gives about 75 g. At 0.5 kcal/g that is about 37 kcal.

Honeydew: about 4 pieces at roughly 20 g each gives about 80 g. At 0.36 kcal/g that is about 29 kcal.

Total: about 155 g and about 66 kcal.
